rationale: Preserve the supplied typed ODE-system contract exactly: time is the only sampled axis; D is the dependent target state; recombination_rate, occupancy_buffer, and refractory_occupancy remain dynamic states per the explicit freedom-change history and must not be demoted to fixed parameters. The chosen window t in [0,25] with 300 points is long enough to show the multiscale transition structure without pushing everything into an almost-flat terminal equilibrium immediately: recombination_rate relaxes on an O(1) timescale toward a higher setpoint, occupancy_buffer responds on a similar but somewhat faster timescale to D^2, and refractory_occupancy evolves more slowly, so the same trajectory can exhibit early changing proportional decay, amplitude-dependent curvature from the nonlinear D term and boundary-compression term, and delayed extra suppression from refractory memory. Parameter values are kept within the suggested magnitudes and away from recovery limits: nonlinear_ld_coupling>0 makes per-unit-LD erosion increase with |D|, boundary_compression_strength>0 counteracts unchecked cubic steepening at larger |D|, and refractory_occupancy_strength>0 with slow refractory_occupancy_relaxation_rate introduces visible but not dominant path-dependent suppression. The initial D=0.05 is modest, so the strongest large-|D| contrasts are not activated immediately; accordingly this dataset will emphasize transient time-varying slope and mild-to-moderate memory/buffering effects rather than extreme boundary compression. No observation noise is added.
